# Budget Car Rental

> > Budget Car Rental offers discounted car rentals, loyalty programs, and flexible rental options including electric vehicles and long-term rentals across the US and internationally.

Budget.com is a comprehensive car rental platform providing booking, reservation management, loyalty programs (Fastbreak and Member Rates), insurance options, and partnerships with major travel and corporate platforms like SAP Concur. The site serves both leisure and business travelers with diverse vehicle options and promotional offers.

- Car Rental

## Booking & Core Services

- [Budget Car Rental Homepage](https://www.budget.com/en/home): Budget Car Rental homepage with booking and service overview
- [Products and Services](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services): Overview of rental add-ons and service offerings
- [Rental Car Programs](https://www.budget.com/en/programs): Budget rental programs including Fastbreak and mini-lease
- [Long Term & Monthly Car Rental](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/services/long-term-car-rental): Monthly and long-term rental options and pricing

## Vehicle Fleet & Options

- [Budget USA Rental Car Guides: All Available Vehicles](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/vehicles/us): Fleet guide covering cars, vans, SUVs, and truck options
- [Electric Car Rental](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/electric-car-rental): Electric vehicle rental options including Tesla and Chevy

## Deals & Offers

- [US Car Rental Deals & Coupons](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/us-offers): US car rental deals, coupons, and promotional offers
- [International Car Rental Deals](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/international): International car rental deals and special offers
- [Partner Car Rental Deals](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/partner-offers): Partner discount offers with Amazon, Universal, and charities

## Loyalty Programs & Enrollment

- [Fastbreak Enrollment](https://www.budget.com/en/loyalty-profile/fastbreak/enrollment): Budget Fastbreak loyalty program enrollment and account setup

## Reservation Management

- [View / Modify / Cancel Reservations](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/view-modify-cancel): Manage reservations: view, modify, or cancel bookings
- [Budget PreCheck](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/precheck): Budget PreCheck service for streamlined rental check-in
- [Car Rental e-Receipts](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/get-e-receipt): Retrieve e-receipts and rental documentation
